notes: DEV fix13 remains the oldest supported DEV updater contract.
DEV fix15 introduced an incompatible path fork by rejecting updater.html/updater.js.
While fix13/fix15/fix16/fix17 may still exist, DEV publication uses portable-replay-safe-v1 dev-delta packages over the common path subset.
fix17 makes updater.html/updater.js optional and replay-safe recovery compatible.
fix18 removes hardcoded DEV branding from popup.js so the same UI source renders DEV or RELEASE from the runtime channel.
fix19 synchronizes background, update-banner and runtime-status build identity to eliminate false TAB/Recargar states.
fix20 hands update execution from the toolbar popup to the service worker after folder authorization and adds a persistent VIENA progress overlay.
fix21 is an intentionally minimal test target for the real fix20 background updater; functional code is unchanged apart from coherent build identity.

fix22 authorizes extension-owned standalone tabs without authorizing web origins, performs folder picking in the standalone page, guards unlink during active updates, and recovers stale background-update state.
fix23 retires only obsolete recovery journal/request/lock state when the running semantic version is already newer than the pending recovery target.
fix24 moves DEV update-manifest reads out of the VIENA content script and uses the service worker state API, eliminating raw.githubusercontent.com CORS failures and invalidated-context polling.

fix25 keeps the hardened standalone-tab authorization path but presents a dedicated folder-link/relink screen, handles picker cancellation as a normal user action, and preserves the worker-safe updater required for the next RELEASE.
fix26 releases the root html width only in standalone folder mode so the dedicated setup card is centered in the full browser tab while preserving the normal 410px toolbar popup.
fix27 hardens RELEASE update identity compatibility plus installation-registry retry and 5-minute heartbeat.
